$comment: Allowlist for catalog-address-guard.test.ts. Every entry is a CONSCIOUS, reviewed exception.
trustedListExempt: addresses absent from CoinGecko per-chain list but verified-real (bytecode + on-chain symbol) — Uniswap-sourced or legit ticker collisions.
symbolMismatchExempt: catalog symbol legitimately differs from on-chain symbol() (artifact/rebrand/wrap); PINNED to the expected on-chain symbol so the exemption is identity-bound.
knownDeprecated: PRE-EXISTING deprecated/migrated legacy tokens the guard surfaced; advisory warn, flagged for Architect cleanup.
duplicateSymbolExempt: same symbol legitimately at >1 address on one chain — ADDRESS-scoped (every colliding address must be listed).
nativeEth: native-ETH sentinel, exempt from on-chain + trusted-list checks.
The guard still FAILS on any NON-allowlisted dead/identity-mismatch/trusted-list-miss/duplicate, so the allowlist never hides a NEW bad token.
knownDeprecated cleared by CHORE-CATALOG-CLEANUP: LCX/RBC replaced with canonical addresses, LOOM/OMNI/REP removed (non-routable/duplicate) — all verified on-chain + official sources.
